located_observations.observation: Substantial chair with two slats and seat. Left cuffed hand stabilizes rail; red cuffed hand holds screwdriver whose visible metal tip meets the circular fastener in the rail.
One green cuffed hand grips screwdriver handle; opposite yellow cuffed hand supports the shaft from below. Tool transfer is recognizable, but receiver does not meet handle.
Collar and sleeves define a blue denim shirt. Green cuffed hand holds fabric and red cuffed hand holds a fine needle at the diagonal stitched tear.
Two distinct people handle chair; two hands hold and stitch a beige patch; yellow cuffed hand cups a red wound spool. Red thread reaches spool around right logistics edge.

Upper-right title and upper-left Latin lead to prominent invitation, then two shared-left sentence lines. Event/date/time row immediately precedes venue/fee/deadline row; URL below deadline is findable. Lower-left proposition closes beside chair.
Large repair contacts wrap the information seam; two upper anchors and invitation are prominent. Contacts define actual boundaries around copy rather than subordinate corner decorations.
Dense woodgrain and blue denim hatching dominate the pictorial material. Title and invitation have heavy squared stems instead of the intended moderate weight.
